findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Usage of expandvars
 * @description expanding variables can potentially expose sensitive environment variables if the input is user controlled.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity medium
 * @id py/expandvars-usage
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-200
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("expandvars").getMember("expandvars").getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember("path").getMember("expandvars").getACall()
select call, "Call to expandvars."
findings.hypothesis: Usage of expandvars might lead to information disclosure if on untrusted input.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Unsafe Reflection
 * @description Using getattr/setattr with user-controlled attribute names can lead to unexpected behavior or security issues.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/unsafe-reflection
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-915
 */

import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call, DataFlow::Node nameArg
where
  (
    call = API::builtin("getattr").getACall() and
    nameArg = call.getArg(1)
  )
  or
  (
    call = API::builtin("setattr").getACall() and
    nameArg = call.getArg(1)
  )
select call, "Reflection using getattr/setattr."
findings.hypothesis: Unsafe reflection using getattr or setattr allows accessing or modifying arbitrary attributes.
